samples.claim: No new model weights go to external users unless that checkpoint's latest dangerous-capability evaluation before the release was a pass, or the lead of the team that owns it signed a waiver first.
samples.finding: Violation found: new weights went to external users without a passing dangerous-capability eval or a prior waiver from the owning team's lead.
samples.reasoning: The claim under audit is: No new model weights go to external users unless that checkpoint's latest dangerous-capability evaluation before the release was a pass, or the lead of the team that owns it signed a waiver first. The deciding details are the eval that isn't a dangerous-capability pass, eval of another checkpoint, eval finished after the release, waiver signed after the release, waiver for another checkpoint, red-team report, recorded in LOG-0009, LOG-0013, LOG-0019, LOG-0049, LOG-0052, LOG-0054, LOG-0067, LOG-0071, LOG-0081, LOG-0091, LOG-0093, LOG-0096, LOG-0105, LOG-0132, LOG-0135, LOG-0149, LOG-0158, LOG-0162, LOG-0163, LOG-0167, LOG-0180. Together these lines show the claim does not hold.
